description: Réservoirs de Troyes Champagne Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Troyes Champagne Métropole. Definition: Tank (water, industrial materials,...) For the list of variables, see pages 108 to 110 of the document "BD TOPO version 3.0 content description": INFORMATION: THE DATA GAME IS AVAILABLE IN THREE FORMATS (.XLSX,.CSV AND.GPKG). THE NUMBER OF REGISTRATION IS IN THE ORDER OF: 252. Coverage: Troyes Champagne Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Tanks of Troyes Champagne Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Troyes Champagne Métropole. Its keywords include troyes-champagne-metropole, reservoirs. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PDF, CSV, GPKG, XLSX. The listing shows 2024-08-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
